newsitem.title: USA: Oregon unemployment dipped to 5.5 pct in January.
newsitem.headline: Oregon unemployment dipped to 5.5 pct in January.

text.p: Oregon's unemployment rate dipped to 5.5 percent in January, down from 6.3 percent in December, the state said on Friday.
"Oregon's unemployment rate is close to the national rate and the state's job growth is rapid and sustained," said David Cooke, an economist with the Oregon Employment Department.
In January, 5,600 jobs were added on a seasonally adjusted basis. The gain was consistent with Oregon's growth over the past year, which averaged 4,900 jobs per month, the department said.
